title: Yamba language
description: Eastern Grassfields language of Cameroon and Nigeria
extract: Yamba is a Grassfields language of the Northwest region of southern Cameroon, with a small number of speakers in Eastern Nigeria. Mbem village has the largest population of Yamba speakers in the region.
